What does a dream wedding look like through the eyes of an American Gypsy bride? Explore the personal stories, wedding aspirations and traditions that shape these celebrations. From choosing the perfect bridal look to preparing for a day filled with family, festivities and expectations, meet the brides whose big dreams take center stage.
Watch My Big Fat American Gypsy Wedding Season 1 Episodes 2, 3, 4 and 5, and Season 3 Episodes 5, 3 and 4 only on discovery+ India.
